# SOC monitoring | Windows authentication
Simulated lab telemetry · November 10, 2026 UTC

Events 4624 and 4625 show successful and failed Windows logons. The final panel correlates eight or more failures in the 15 minutes before a success on the same account, source IP, and destination.

The trend is grouped by UTC event time. The chart axis may display your browser time zone.

content.title: Authentication totals
content.query:
SimulatedWindowsAuth_CL
| where TimeGenerated >= datetime(2026-11-10) and TimeGenerated < datetime(2026-11-11)
| where IsSimulated == true and EventID in (4624, 4625)
| summarize Total=count(), Successful=countif(EventID == 4624), Failed=countif(EventID == 4625)

content.title: Authentication trends · 30-minute UTC buckets
content.query:
SimulatedWindowsAuth_CL
| where TimeGenerated >= datetime(2026-11-10) and TimeGenerated < datetime(2026-11-11)
| where IsSimulated == true and EventID in (4624, 4625)
| summarize Successful=countif(EventID == 4624), Failed=countif(EventID == 4625) by bin(TimeGenerated, 30m)
| order by TimeGenerated asc

content.title: Failed logons by account
content.query:
SimulatedWindowsAuth_CL
| where TimeGenerated >= datetime(2026-11-10) and TimeGenerated < datetime(2026-11-11)
| where IsSimulated == true and EventID in (4624, 4625)
| where EventID == 4625
| summarize Failed=count() by Account
| order by Failed desc, Account asc

content.title: Eight or more failures followed by success
content.query:
let Auth = SimulatedWindowsAuth_CL
| where TimeGenerated >= datetime(2026-11-10) and TimeGenerated < datetime(2026-11-11)
| where IsSimulated == true and EventID in (4624, 4625) | where IsSimulated == true and EventID in (4624,4625) | where isnotempty(Account) and isnotempty(IpAddress) and isnotempty(Computer);
Auth | where EventID == 4624 | project Account, IpAddress, Computer, SuccessTime=TimeGenerated
| join kind=inner (Auth | where EventID == 4625 | project Account, IpAddress, Computer, FailureTime=TimeGenerated) on Account, IpAddress, Computer
| where FailureTime < SuccessTime and FailureTime >= SuccessTime - 15m
| summarize Failures=count(), FirstFailure=min(FailureTime), LastFailure=max(FailureTime) by Account, IpAddress, Computer, SuccessTime
| where Failures >= 8
| extend TimeGenerated=SuccessTime
| project Account, SourceIP=IpAddress, Destination=Computer, Failures, FirstFailureUTC=format_datetime(FirstFailure,'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.fff'), LastFailureUTC=format_datetime(LastFailure,'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.fff'), SuccessUTC=format_datetime(SuccessTime,'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.fff')
